title: P3-focus frame
description: One frame of the world's own record of a step (A §1.2), emitted by src/p3focus/world.py. Schema "1" is the old line's telemetry frame (p3_crafter_body_errands_94/design/telemetry_frame_schema.json) verbatim; schema "2" is that document plus `standing_on` and nothing else (A §7, D4). What is deliberately absent is part of the contract: no far terrain, no object detail beyond the window, no pixels. Vocabulary (materials, items, achievements) is that of the pinned vendor, danijar/crafter@e04542a2 + PR #32, src/vendor/crafter/data.yaml; src/tests/test_frame_schema.py asserts the two agree.

schema_version.description: Bumped only by a breaking change to this document. "2" = the old line's frame plus standing_on.

step.description: env._step: 0 for the post-reset frame, +1 per world step.

pos.description: [x, y] in WORLD coordinates: +x right, +y DOWN (A §1.1). The shown axis the model reads is y_shown = 63 - y_world and is never in a log.

facing.description: [dx, dy] unit offset of the cell the player acts on, world axis. Left/right/up/down = [-1,0]/[+1,0]/[0,-1]/[0,+1] (objects.py:175). Raw on purpose: naming is the page layer's job.

inventory.description: The full inventory dict, including the four vitals duplicated under player.

window.description: Square, odd-sided, player-centred crop of our own SemanticView (the stock one omits Fence, env.py:47-49), ids mapped to names. Rows run north->south (+y, world axis: row 0 is the row ABOVE the body on screen), columns west->east (+x), matching the transpose in Env.render, so the centre cell is always the player. This line's window is 9x9; squareness, oddness and the centred player are asserted by the tests, not expressible here.

standing_on.description: The material of the cell under the body, read from the material map. Schema "2"'s one addition (A §1.2, D4): the window draws the player OVER their own cell, so `window[4][4]` is "player" and the window cannot answer this at all. Under this line's rules it is the difference between the drink meter rising (water) and falling (sand).

achievements.description: The full 22 achievement counters (env.py:110). Monotonically non-decreasing within an episode. Never on a page; kept because the frame is the old line's verbatim.

deltas.description: Change since the previous committed frame. Sparse: only names that changed appear. Empty on the frame-0 frame. Summing them over a run reconciles exactly with the final counters.

additionalProperties.description: Signed change; never 0 (a 0 entry means the emitter is not sparse).

level.description: Every inventory item is clamped to 0..max, and every max in data.yaml is 9 (objects.py:126-128).

material.description: The 12 materials of the pinned vendor. A cell of the material map, which is what `standing_on` reads; no object name and no pad can appear there, because the body is always inside the world and always on a material.

cell.description: 12 materials, the 7 object classes of our SemanticView (Fence included), semantic id 0 (never produced by worldgen), and the pad used outside the world.
